question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: The Nobel Prize, established in 1901, is the world's most prestigious award for outstanding contributions to physics, chemistry, literature, medicine, peace, and economics. It was named after Alfred Bernard Nobel, inventor of dynamite, who left a large sum of money and a will to be awarded to individuals for their contributions to these fields. Economics was added in 1969.
